newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Freddev lifts half yr shr earnings, no div.
newsitem.headline: Freddev lifts half yr shr earnings, no div.

text.p: Half year ended December 31 (million rand unless stated)
Full name: Free State Development and Investment Corporation Ltd (mining exploration)

NOTE - No interim dividend has been declared. Payment of dividends by the company in future will be largely determined by the nature and extent to which the mineral rights portfolio can be turned to account.

The group said it would -- in conjunction with various mining houses -- actively encourage investigations which could lead to the establishment of new mining activity in areas where Freddev properties are situated.
